text:
The 8 desks for Oak Street are due Friday, October 30, between 09:00 and 12:00. The carrier hasn't sent a tracking number yet so you'll have to watch for that window. You'll need to keep the loading bay clear then.

You can drop the well wishes and the talk of navigating things together. They don't add anything to what you actually need from the other side. If you want to keep a bit of the old politeness a plain thanks at the end will do.
